text: Amended 2026-11-21 by decision mimid-1wgh.81 (bug mimid-jvde): the hub still sends its own tree as full whatever the client sent, but only while the Welcome FanoutMessage with it fits MAX_BODY_LEN; a longer one goes with distributionService and the joiners fetch the tree by groupInfo, and if that cannot fit either the Commit is refused.
